title: Ayurvedic Soap for Dark Spots & Marks

details.description:
Indulekha soap bar is an Ayurvedic Proprietary Medicine Soap that helps repair visible signs of skin damage in 4 weeks. It is not a regular soap, but an ayurvedic medicine for your skin.
The Soap is formulated with potent Ayurvedic ingredients that are known to help with skin concerns such as dark spots, marks, uneven skin tone and pore appearance. 84% of users in the clinical study showed improvement from visible signs of skin damage. This potent bar is made with Manjishthadi Tailam, which is a unique combination of four Ayurvedic ingredients namely Manjishtha (Indian Madder), Yashtimadhu (Liquorice), Matulunga (Citron) and Laksha (Lac).
In Ayurveda, the use of Manjishthadi Tailam is known to cure minor skin problems, improve skin health & provide golden glowing skin. It is also known to treat skin inflammation like boils and acne & to reduce the appearance of dark patches, by inhibiting tyrosinase enzyme a key regulator in melanin production on the skin as known in modern science.
The soap also helps in the reduction of sebum secretion and improvement in hydration which is known to manage excess oiliness on the skin and the formation of acne lesions. As per Ayurveda, excessive oiliness is the result of imbalance occurring in the pitta doshas where cleansing with lukewarm water and using a balanced formulation containing pitta pacifying herbs such as Manjishtha & Yashtimadhu are known to help in the oily skin care management.
For glowing skin, use 2 times a day for 4 weeks, because regular usage of products is recommended in Ayurveda. Based on a clinical study conducted by an independent research organization in 2021.
details.usageInstructions:
Wet the bar with water and lather on your palms.
Apply on your wet face & body and massage well.
Rinse thoroughly and pat the skin dry.
For best results, use twice a day, morning and evening for 4 weeks.
